remarks: Situated on a prime corner lot in the sought-after Springdale neighborhood, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home sits on nearly half an acre. The open-concept living area features vaulted ceilings and seamless access to a private deck through sliding doors, creating a bright and inviting space. Downstairs, the cozy family room boasts a fireplace and additional sliders leading to a charming patio. With a large two-car garage and mature landscaping, this property combines beauty and functionality. Conveniently located across from a park and close to amenities, this home is full of potential, ready for your personal touch to make it truly shine. Property is being sold As-Is.
